steps.title: Left to right
steps.say: Rest your hand palm up. I'll draw a slow line from left to right. Left is the past. Right is today.
steps.alt: A flat line across the palm from left to right.

steps.title: Up means up
steps.say: Now a line that climbs. When the line moves up, the price went up.

steps.title: The tap
steps.say: Feel that tap? A tap always means something important happened, like a peak or a finished trade.
steps.alt: One tap in the center of the palm.

quiz.q: Where on your palm is today?
quiz.why: Drawings always move from the past on the left to today on the right.
